newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CARELESS DRIVING COSTS INJURED PLAYER EXTRA HEADACHE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CARELESS DRIVING COSTS INJURED PLAYER EXTRA HEADACHE.

text.p: Sevilla's Marcos Martin must have thought his luck had really run out when his head hit a goalpost while he was being stretchered from the field on a golf buggy.

The driver drove too close to the posts as Martin was lying flat-out in the back of the buggy after picking up a heavy knock in Sunday's game against Tenerife. He has subsequently recovered from both injuries.
